what: Inside a tall section (default 150vh) a screen-height panel is pinned, and three overlapping circles in the center grow with scroll until they cover the screen, from when the section top touches the top of the screen (0) to when the section end passes the top of the screen (100). The panel stays pinned for only the first 50vh, so the circles keep growing after the panel leaves: center panel .4→1.3 (0~15), title turns on at 4→5, dark circle 4vh→10vw (0~10)→70vw (10~35), pale circle 4vh→15vw (0~15)→200vw (15~57), outer faint circle (.26) 65vh→200vh (0~57). It follows the scroll with a .5s lag. A transition where a yellow circle wraps the one-line intro after the hero and becomes the next section’s background

options.scrub: Seconds of trailing delay, default .5 (original Webflow smoothing 50)
options.grow: End size of the dark circle, default 70vw (250vw on the phone original)
options.outerFrom: Initial size of the outer circle, default 65vh (phone original 50vh)
options.start · end: ScrollTrigger, default top top · bottom top
